detail.longDescription: I've been playing this game at coffee shops where every time I overhear somebody say they're "building with AI," I take a sip of my cold brew. Suffice it to say, I'm staying caffeinated (and staying up at night). Your IT admins may be losing sleep too, if everyone's handing AI tools like Claude access to their work apps, giving it more chances to do something it shouldn't.
